bug_fixes: Removed any remaining references to 'Humidity Delta' in the codebase and UI to prevent confusion after the switch to absolute internal humidity thresholds.
Fixed anomaly chart incorrectly highlighting data based on the humidity delta instead of absolute internal humidity.
new_features: Predictive Desiccant Saturation: Calculates internal humidity climb rate to estimate hours until silica failure.
Added a live 'Time to Saturation' warning indicator to the main dashboard.
Added 'Predictive Warning Window' setting to configuration to adjust how early alerts trigger.
general_changes: Replaced 'Humidity Delta' alert logic with an 'Absolute Internal Humidity' threshold to prevent false positives in dry rooms and false negatives in humid rooms.
Removed the delta line from the Environmental History chart for better clarity.
Version 0.1.0 Beta release - major milestone with new features and improvements. Expect frequent updates.
Version 0.0.0 initial commit with basic functionality and setup
